# Contributing to DashCalc

Thanks for wanting to help! DashCalc is a one-person project, and I'm learning JavaScript by building it. Here's how help works best.

## Ways to help

- **Report a bug.** Use the [bug report form](https://github.com/Xernosz/DashCalc/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). Say what phone and browser you use, what you typed, and what happened.
- **Suggest an idea.** Use the [idea form](https://github.com/Xernosz/DashCalc/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml). Tell me what happens on your dashes and what would help.
- **Test on iPhone.** I can't test Safari myself, so if something looks off on an iPhone, please report it.
- **Suggest code.** Open an issue that points at the problem, or paste your fix right in it.

## Pull requests

Please open an issue first. You can open a pull request, but don't expect me to merge it. I write the code myself so I actually learn, so a pull request is most useful to me as a suggestion.

## Rules that never change

- **DashCalc never touches your delivery accounts.** No login, no scraping, no screen reading.
- **Your data stays on your phone.** Offers, pay, miles and settings never leave the device.
- **No extra tracking.** The anonymous visit count described on the [privacy page](https://xernosz.github.io/DashCalc/legal.html#counting) is the only thing DashCalc sends. No other analytics and no third-party scripts.

Anything that breaks these won't be added.

## Be decent

Everyone here follows the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Security problems go through [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), never a public issue.
